name: MX Haptics
description: Haptic feedback on the Logitech MX Master 4 mouse for in-game events (damage taken, shield blocks, air bubbles, blocks broken/placed, hotbar changes). REQUIRES: the HapticWeb plugin installed in Logi Options+ (available from the Logi Marketplace), and a compatible Logitech MX Master 4 mouse. Client-side only, works on any server.
